integrity: The proof is self-contained from primary decomposition, local-module idempotents, and the reduction map on general linear groups. Finite enumeration is used only as a consistency check and not as an infinite proof.
limitations: The closed product formula assumes that every primary module is homogeneous.
Nonhomogeneous primary types require a finer idempotent count in their endomorphism rings.
The finite verifier checks representative fields and small local rings; the all-parameter statement rests on the symbolic proof.
title: Strong-clean multiplicities for homogeneous primary finite-field matrices
